subject: Diving Minigame
text: In the Diving Minigame, position yourself above the rupees thrown off the waterfall and hold down A as you dive down to grab them.

evidence.quote: The Zora will throw a handful of rupees off the waterfall, which you need to dive down and grab.  Simply position yourself above the rupees, and hold down A as you dive down to grab them.

subject: Zora
text: Once you grab all the rupees from around the waterfall in the Diving Minigame, return to the Zora to receive the Silver Scale, which doubles diving depth.

evidence.quote: Once you have grabbed all of the rupees from around the waterfall, the Zora will call down for you to return to him and he'll give you a reward.  He'll give you the Silver Scale, which doubles how deep you can go in a single dive.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: At the Fishing Pond, Z-Target a fish, hit B to cast, use B, A, and the joystick to attract fish, then hold down A and pull back on the control stick to reel in.

evidence.quote: Z-Target a fish, then hit B to cast.  Use the B button, the A button and the joystick to play with the lure and attract fish to the fly.  The biggest fish are found near the submerged log on the left side of the pond and the reeds on the right.  Once a fish is on the line, hold down A and pull backwards on the control stick to reel the fish in.

subject: Fishing Pond
text: The biggest fish at the Fishing Pond are located near the submerged log on the left side of the pond and the reeds on the right.

evidence.quote: The biggest fish are found near the submerged log on the left side of the pond and the reeds on the right.

subject: Bigocto
text: Bigocto is vulnerable to the Boomerang, which stuns him and locks him in place, exposing his weakpoint green eye on his backside.

evidence.quote: His weakpoint is a large green "eye" on his backside.  The Bigocto is vulnerable to the Boomerang - it stuns him and locks him in place.

subject: Bigocto
text: Two Jump Attacks to Bigocto's green eye on his backside will defeat him.

evidence.quote: Once you have reached his backside, stun him with the Boomerang, and use a Jump Attack to damage his green eye.  Two Jump Attacks will defeat the Bigocto.

subject: Bigocto
text: Letting Bigocto run into you causes him to turn around, allowing you to stun and attack his backside quickly.

evidence.quote: Another alternative is to simply let him run into you.  He will then turn around, letting you stun him and attack him.  This is less glamorous and sloppier, but works much more quickly and easily.

subject: Amy Poe
text: The real Amy does a spin when splitting into four versions; shoot the spinning Amy with an arrow to force another split and repeat.

evidence.quote: The real Amy does a little spin when she first splits up.  Shoot this Amy with an arrow, and she will split into four new Amys.  Wait for the real Amy to spin, and shoot her again.

subject: Flare Dancer
text: Separate the Flare Dancer's heart from its flaming body using the Hookshot, then intercept the running heart and damage it with a jump attack.

evidence.quote: To damage the Flare Dancer, the first thing you must do is separate it's heart from it's flaming body using the Hookshot.  Once this is done, the heart will literally begin running around the room very quickly.  Begin circling the room in the opposite direction so that you intercept it halfway around the room, and use a jump attack to deal damage to it (use a regular strike if you have difficulty timing the jump attack).

subject: Flare Dancer
text: Using the Biggoron Sword on the Flare Dancer results in a faster victory.

evidence.quote: If you have the Biggoron Sword, then use it for a faster victory.

subject: Shadow Link
text: Shadow Link cannot deflect the Megaton Hammer, making smacking him with it an easy victory.

evidence.quote: This means using the Megaton Hammer.  He can't deflect the Megaton Hammer.  He won't even try.  Just smack him around with it until he dies.

subject: Shadow Link
text: Do not perform a stab attack against Shadow Link, and avoid Z-Targeting if using regular sword attacks.

evidence.quote: The first thing to know when fighting Shadow Link: do not perform a Stab attack (forward + attack while Z-targeted)... If you're a combat purist and refuse to use such an easy tactic, then the second-best way to beat him is to use regular sword attacks, but don't Z-Target him.

subject: Deadhand
text: Allow a hand to grab you to make Deadhand appear, struggle free by rotating the stick and pressing buttons, then hit his lowered head with a Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: Allow one of his hands to grab you, and Deadhand's body and head will appear and move slowly towards you.  Struggle free of the hand holding you by rotating the control stick and slamming buttons, then Z-Target Deadhand's head.  Stand still (out of the range of the hands), and wait for Deadhand to get near you, at which point his head will lower to attack.  Execute a Jump Attack before Deadhand can attack, and he will begin to run away, eventually sinking back into the ground.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Iron Knuckles can be defeated quickly by casting Nayru's Love and attacking while invulnerable.

evidence.quote: Or the easier, faster method is to just use Nayru's Love and go kamikaze while you are invulnerable.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: As Adult Link, wait for the Iron Knuckle to attack, backflip out of range, land with a Jump Attack, and immediately backflip away again.

evidence.quote: First, wait for the Iron Knuckle to attack, then backflip out of the attack's range.  As soon as you land, use a Jump Attack, and then immediately backflip out of the range of the Knuckle's next attack.  Use another Jump Attack, backflip away, and repeat until the Knuckle is defeated.

subject: Gohma
text: Shoot Gohma in the eye with the Slingshot while her eye glows red to stun her and make her vulnerable to sword jump attacks.

evidence.quote: To stun Gohma and make her vulnerable to basic sword attacks, you must shoot her in the eye with the Slingshot while her eye glows red.

subject: Gohma
text: If you shoot Gohma in the eye before she can spawn Gohma Larva on the ceiling, she will fall and remain stunned for a long time.

evidence.quote: If you can shoot her in the eye before she is able spawn them, however, then she will fall to the floor and be stunned for a VERY long time.  You can easily get in three or four more Jump Attacks at this point, which are more then enough to shut down Gohma permanently.

subject: King Dodongo
text: When King Dodongo begins inhaling during his first phase, throw a Bomb into his mouth to stun him for a Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: In order to damage him, you must wait for him to begin inhaling in the first phase, and quickly throw a Bomb into his mouth.  The bomb will explode in his stomach, stunning the King Dodongo for a few seconds.  You are given only one sword swing when he is stunned, so make it a Jump Attack.

subject: King Dodongo
text: Avoid King Dodongo's rolling attack by standing on the edge of the lava or in a corner of the room; three Jump Attacks or six normal sword attacks will kill him.

evidence.quote: Stand on the edge of the lava or in one of the corners of the room to avoid his rolling attack... After three Jump Attacks or six normal sword attacks, Dodongo will die.

subject: Barinade
text: Circle Barinade continuously to avoid lightning bolts while using the Boomerang to destroy the tentacles attached to the ceiling.

evidence.quote: Z-Target the tentacles attached to the ceiling, and begin circling the boss.  It doesn't matter what direction you choose to circle in, but stick with it.  Changing course will result in you getting electrocuted.  Destroy the tentacles attached to the ceiling with the Boomerang.

subject: Barinade
text: In phase two, dodge through the circling Baris, strike Barinade's base with the Boomerang to stun the boss and release the Baris, then destroy them with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Dodge through the circling Biris, and stun the boss by striking it's base with the Boomerang.  The Baris will release from their bonding to Barinade, and become vulnerable.  Destroy them with your Boomerang.
